items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: And so I played with him for a long time after that, you know... Edward. Edward Clam, yeah.

ctx.x: I remember he had a shoeshine place. Yeah, well. At Eagle Saloon.

Oh, that was before that shoeshine place. Before then. Yeah, that was before then. He was living right there. You know where the old Zulu club was on the side? Yeah. In that corner, right near Ramport Street. Yeah. Two-story place there. Well, he was, I went there and he had a room upstairs. You know, he didn't have an apartment, you see. And I told him what Clem said. He said, well, you go ahead. He was kind of an independent fellow, you know. He said, you go ahead and play with him. I said, no, I don't want to…
